facts.value: The benefits office needs more documents to keep reviewing your housing benefit application.
facts.evidence: To continue our review, we need more information from you.

facts.value: Send a copy of your current lease and proof of income for the last three months.
facts.evidence: Please send us a copy of your current lease and proof of your income for the last three months.

facts.value: within 30 days of the date of this letter
facts.evidence: You must send these documents within 30 days of the date of this letter.

facts.value: Put the file reference on every page you send.
facts.evidence: Please include the file reference on every page.
